rca of the issue: Original bug: chauffeur-livreur profiles saw 'Job Dating Numérique & IT' surfacing at the top of recommendations because (1) inferred_sectors iterated via a non-deterministic set() so 'best sector bonus' was random, (2) matching split job titles on generic words like 'chef', 'projet', 'agent' which cross-matched 'Chef de projet IT' to any profile mentioning 'chef' or 'agent', (3) 'entretien' keyword ambiguously mapped to Propreté via 'entretien du véhicule' from driver profiles. Fix in /app/backend/routes/jobdating.py: (a) rank inferred_sectors as an ordered list and pick min rank across event sectors, (b) filter GENERIC_WORDS from job/skill tokens before substring matching, (c) cap match_score at 20 when no sector nor experience match is found, plus disambiguation in database.py _SECTOR_KEYWORDS Propreté. Verified: IT event score drops from ~top position to 30 (moyen/faible tier) for both michel and mike.
